acceptance_criteria: LB-01 the binding record's key set matches the frozen schema exactly; a missing, extra or mistyped key is RUN_LOCK_BINDING_METHOD_FAILURE
LB-02 bound_manifest_sha256 matches the bound manifest byte for byte; flipping one byte of the manifest yields RUN_LOCK_MISMATCH
LB-03 lock_record_sha256 and environment_locked_sha256 are two different quantities, each with a positive control proving they differ on the same record
LB-04 no field of RUN_LOCK_BINDING_V1 is named environment_lock_sha256; a test asserts the absence directly
LB-05 MEASURED plus PARTIAL_LOCK yields RUN_LOCK_INSUFFICIENT and never RUN_LOCK_BOUND; an input that would pass a lock_class-only check must be refused
LB-06 a run directory with no binding record yields RUN_LOCK_UNBOUND, and that label is never treated as PASS by any consumer
LB-07 binding_mode SIDECAR_ONLY with a null sidecar_reason, and EMBEDDED_AND_SIDECAR with a non-null sidecar_reason, both fail closed
LB-08 an absolute path, a path containing .., or a non-canonical POSIX path in bound_manifest_path or lock_record_path fails closed
LB-09 each of the five labels has a positive control; RUN_LOCK_BINDING_METHOD_FAILURE has a test proving it is never downgraded
LB-10 PAPER_RUN_MANIFEST_V2 without the environment_lock block fails closed; PAPER_RUN_MANIFEST_V1 carrying it also fails closed; every existing V1 fixture keeps passing
LB-11 the analysis module is stdlib-only, proved by an AST-parsing test, so it can be replayed under python -I -S
LB-12 after implementation the SHA-256 of backend/rl/train_ppo.py, backend/rl/eval_policy.py and backend/simulator.py equal the values pinned in immutable_sources below

binding_modes.EMBEDDED_AND_SIDECAR: the manifest schema carries the lock block itself AND a sidecar binding record is written; sidecar_reason must be null
binding_modes.SIDECAR_ONLY: only the sidecar binding record is written, because embedding would falsify a pinned digest or turn a currently green test red; sidecar_reason must name that digest or test

claim_boundary: Passing this contract establishes only that a retained run manifest and one ENVIRONMENT-LOCK-V1 record are linked by a recomputable relation, and that the record is MEASURED and FULL_LOCK.
It supports no statement about the correctness of any numeric result, any task PASS, any controller superiority, or any change to paper_data_ready, statistics_ready or method_level_power_ready.
It supports no physical feasibility, safety, sim-to-real or actuator claim.
It does not assert that a run can be reproduced on another machine: the lock detects environment differences, it does not guarantee cross-environment numeric identity.
This contract is infrastructure, not evidence. It produces no citable measurement.
disclosure: Three facts were measured before this design was fixed, and each one changed the scope. (1) The field name environment_lock_sha256 already carries two different quantities in two retained bundles whose lock records share an identical locked_sha256, so the retained values differ for definitional rather than environmental reasons. (2) backend/test_v7_candidate_selection_contract.py re-hashes backend/rl/eval_policy.py and asserts it equals a digest pinned in a protocol the project owner authorized on 2026-09-10, so editing that driver turns a green test red. (3) backend/rl/training_seed_variance_protocol.json pins backend/rl/train_ppo.py by digest with nothing enforcing it at runtime, so editing that driver would silently falsify an executed protocol. Fact (2) corrects an earlier statement made during design that nothing re-hashes the driver digests: that was true of the seed-variance source_baseline and false of the candidate-selection execution_precondition_source_digests.

enforcement_scope.rationale: Retained contracts compare key sets exactly and their retained evidence digests are pinned, so adding a field without versioning would make retained evidence fail its own contract. Fail-closed enforcement is therefore added to new schemas only.
unchanged_contracts: ENVIRONMENT_LOCK_RECORD_V1 and every function in backend/environment_lock.py

execution_order: LB-PRE-01 measure and record the SHA-256 of the three files that must not change, and the three disclosure facts
freeze this protocol and docs/RUN_MANIFEST_LOCK_BINDING_SPEC.md, commit and push; no producer may be edited before this push
modify backend/paper_data_contract.py and the two bundle builders
provide a sidecar binding entry point for the two RL drivers without editing the drivers
run the verification gate; write the receipt only after it is green

retained_seed_variance_bundle.reason_not_regenerated: The 15 retained run_manifest.json files carry no lock field at all, so nothing can support or refute the two hard-coded True values. Reading them from the manifest would force both to False and fail CELL_LOCK_FIELDS; regenerating the bundle would change the raw_replicates.json digest that the analysis directory and r0_regime_probe_protocol.json parent_summary_sha256 already pin; and the 15 training runs cannot be re-executed because the v5 warm start provenance is unrecoverable.
retained_seed_variance_bundle.resolution: Record them as known, non-reverifiable assertions. The binding constrains only runs produced after this freeze.

forward_only_posture.retro_fit_forbidden: No binding record is manufactured for evidence retained before this freeze. A record created afterwards could not honestly claim verified_before_run=true.

immutable_sources.rule: LB-12 requires these three to be byte-unchanged after implementation. Each is immutable for a distinct measured reason recorded in the specification sections 2.2, 2.3 and 3.4.

lock_requirement.evidence_run_rule: A run governed by a frozen protocol (its manifest carries seedvar_protocol or pilot_protocol, or its run_class is FORMAL_EVALUATION) refuses to start when satisfies_full_lock_requirement is false.
lock_requirement.forbidden_gate: lock_class alone. A MEASURED record with PARTIAL_LOCK means a fingerprint could not be measured and is RUN_LOCK_INSUFFICIENT, not a pass.
lock_requirement.other_run_rule: Smoke, preflight and local development runs record the measured class and completeness truthfully and are not blocked; the analysis-time gate carries the other half.
lock_requirement.sequencing: The lock is captured and verified before any bound data is produced. verified_before_run may be true only when that order held. Capturing at manifest-assembly time records the environment at write time, not the environment that produced the data.

outcome_labels.RUN_LOCK_BINDING_METHOD_FAILURE: any contract violation: unknown schema, key-set mismatch, malformed digest, path escape, sidecar_reason inconsistent with binding_mode, or a lock record that cannot be read or validated
outcome_labels.RUN_LOCK_BOUND: the binding record is present and schema-valid, bound_manifest_sha256 matches the manifest byte for byte, and satisfies_full_lock_requirement is true
outcome_labels.RUN_LOCK_INSUFFICIENT: the binding record is present and consistent, but satisfies_full_lock_requirement is false
outcome_labels.RUN_LOCK_MISMATCH: the binding record is present but bound_manifest_sha256 does not match the manifest, or bound_manifest_path points elsewhere
outcome_labels.RUN_LOCK_UNBOUND: the run directory carries no binding record

outcome_semantics: RUN_LOCK_UNBOUND and RUN_LOCK_INSUFFICIENT are results rather than failures and must be reported as such, but neither is a PASS and no upstream contract may treat either as bound. RUN_LOCK_BINDING_METHOD_FAILURE may never be downgraded to any of the other four. A threshold may not be relaxed because of a result: any change requires a new contract version disclosing that it was designed with the result already known.

out_of_scope.backend/simulator.py: The meta.provenance record enters a deterministic content hash whose excluded-field list is frozen and independently recomputed by backend/test_p0_contract.py, and /api/simulate is a stateless request/response rather than a retained run manifest (backend/run_traces/ is gitignored). This is the one explicit exception to 'every pipeline' on day one and must not be dropped from later documents.
out_of_scope.roadmap_item_1_remainder: Actual matrix execution and immutable evidence storage are the other half of ROADMAP section 9 item 1 and are not in this contract.

producers_in_scope.sidecar_reason: Editing this file would silently falsify source_baseline.training_driver_source_sha256 in the executed SEEDVAR-V7-TRAINING-REPLICATE-DEV-V1 protocol, which nothing re-derives at runtime; that protocol JSON is itself pinned by test_training_seed_variance_contract.py and by r0_regime_probe_protocol.json parent_protocol_sha256.

backend/test_v7_candidate_selection_contract.py re-hashes this file and asserts it equals execution_precondition_source_digests.evaluation_driver_source_sha256 of SELECT-V7-CANDIDATE-FORMAL-V1, the protocol the project owner authorized on 2026-09-10 against sha256:b4e16370b5744c510fa11b06343dafb3c1893711639721a406504720bbe99b58.

record.location: the same directory as the manifest it binds

commands: python -m pytest backend/test_run_manifest_lock.py backend/test_paper_data_contract.py backend/test_v1_analytical_bundle.py backend/test_paired_statistics_contract.py backend/test_experiment_matrix_contract.py backend/test_v7_candidate_selection_contract.py backend/test_training_seed_variance_contract.py backend/test_p0_contract.py -q
verification_gate.note: This repository has no .github directory and no CI at all, so the gate is exactly these two commands run from the repository root. Both must be green before a receipt is written.

vocabulary.environment_locked_sha256: the canonical digest of the locked subtree, from environment_lock.validate_lock_record(record)['locked_sha256']
vocabulary.forbidden_reason: The same name already carries the lock file bytes in backend/second_case_evidence/2026-09-08/bundle/raw_replicates.json (sha256:911b436231c8e0b1d7a3d07bca6894ce4c42c517c4a5cbbbdd0f9dff694ff631) and the locked subtree digest in backend/seed_variance_evidence/2026-09-08/bundle/raw_replicates.json (sha256:93d23a2703adc86a1394eacf5dece8d7229fdf742857f1a271656aa1cfeac72d), while both executions ran under records whose locked_sha256 is identical. A reader comparing the two retained values would wrongly conclude the two bundles came from different environments.
vocabulary.lock_record_sha256: the SHA-256 of the lock record file bytes
